title: feat: add pr-mender, a PR review-and-fix agent (Fixes #17245)
author: afanasevmylife

gist.summary: afanasevmylife added PR Mender for quest #17245, callable as `community/afanasevmylife/pr-mender`. Given a GitHub PR link, the `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` agent uses the `computer` MCP to read the PR diff and surrounding files at its head SHA, then returns SHIP if it finds no correctness issue. For a finding, it prepares `review.md`, an applicable `fix.diff`, and corrected files on a `pr-mender/pr-<N>-fix` branch in `pollinations/collective-memory`; it does not push to the caller’s fork. The README links demo transcripts, including a fix for an SSE parser not flushed at end of stream, and documents the sandbox and tool-call constraints.
